race.comment: HIGHLAND BLING (3) is going very well and will relish the 3200m here. He was a bit stiff not to win the 2800m race at Flemington on Cup Day with 59.5kg, held up in the straight before just missing BEACH PAD. He drops right down to 54kg here and is a Sydney & Adelaide Cup placegetter over this trip. The query is the ground - his heavy track run in Australia was poor, but if the stable are happy to run, he's a big chance. AUTUMN MYSTERY (5) ran well in the 2800m race to grab fourth behind BEACH PAD (6) who was given a good ride by Pike to win. They all meet BEACH PAD much better off at the weights now. ASTERIX (2) form on paper doesn't look great but he's been in much stronger races. 3rd to Zahrann & Saint George earlier in the Spring says he's absolutely good enough. MANZOR BLUE (4) was a big price in the G3 Queen Elizabeth Stakes but ran a cracker when 2nd to Pinhole which is top form. A repeat of that goes close and he is a 3200m winner in New Zealand.
